name: Hani Tsuma Hs ~After Wedding~
original_name: はにつまHs ～アフターウェディング～
source:
This is the ero-filled fandisc for Hanitsuma. Hibiki’s relationship with his partner grows increasingly closer. To affirm his decision to his father, he proposed to her and their sweet married life begins.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/10/01/october-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《人妻花嫁》的色情粉丝碟。响与恋人的关系越来越亲密。为了向父亲表明决心，他向恋人求婚，两人的甜蜜婚后生活由此开始。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/10/01/october-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau～Omochikaeri！[/url]]
